executiveSummary: The September 3 client meeting was prepared and recorded, and the team reported delivery of some therapist videos. A file-opening concern was followed up with a producer check. The next production priorities are the remaining videos, still images from the AI video and website changes. The available evidence does not yet confirm delivery of the full video set.

work.title: Meeting agenda circulated for the September 3 client meeting
work.detail: An agenda was emailed to the client contact the day before the meeting, with Momentum stakeholders copied, inviting additions.
work.whyItMatters: Shows the client meeting was prepared rather than ad hoc, and gives the meeting a documented scope.

work.title: Client meeting recorded
work.detail: A meeting notification confirms the September 3 session and availability of a recording. The full recap was not accessible in the reviewed material, so specific decisions are not attributed to that meeting.
work.whyItMatters: Preserves the meeting record while keeping unverified outcomes out of the report.

work.title: Delivered files checked after an opening concern
work.detail: Following a client-reported file concern, the producer reported that both delivered files opened without an issue on their system. This was an opening check, not an independent malware scan or a determination of the cause of the client’s computer issue.
work.whyItMatters: Documents the follow-up and the actual limit of the check.

work.title: Partial video delivery and next production priorities reported
work.detail: The weekly update reported that some videos had been sent and named still-image extraction and website changes as the next priorities. A September 4 update had also said the remaining therapist videos were being queued for delivery.
work.whyItMatters: Shows what has progressed and which deliverables still need a receipt.

nextSteps.title: Extract still images from the AI video
nextSteps.detail: Named as a priority for the week of September 7.

nextSteps.title: Website changes
nextSteps.detail: Named as a priority for the week of September 7 alongside the still-image extraction.

nextSteps.title: Send the remaining therapist videos
nextSteps.detail: Producer committed on September 4 to sending all remaining videos to the client contact.

caveats: Only some videos are reported delivered. A receipt for the remaining final files is still needed.
The full meeting recap was unavailable; no unverified meeting decisions are included.
Successful opening of a file does not establish a security diagnosis.
headline: From video to the next website update.
summaryFollow: The actions below separate verified changes, reported progress and work awaiting review.
